subject: Order Form change request: NovaApps throughput bump & SOW clarifications
messages:
From: Sarah Lewis <sarah.lewis@novaapps.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: NovaApps Procurement <procurement@novaapps.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Order Form change — requested throughput increase + SOW clarifications

Hi Marcus / Laura,

Following our technical sync last week, we ran updated load tests and need to push the committed throughput for the pilot from 2,000 TPS to 3,000 TPS (roughly +50% token throughput). That change will impact the order form SKU mix and the implementation SOW (we'll need the additional GPU reserve and a brief rework of the ingestion pipeline acceptance tests).

Can you confirm:
- Whether this is handled via a Change Order (amendment to the Order Form + SOW) or via a separate supplemental Exhibit?
- What the delta in monthly fees will be (ballpark is fine for now) and any implications for our September onboarding target?

Attaching our short change request PDF and a usage estimate. Happy to hop on a quick 20-min call if helpful.

Attachments: NovaApps_Requested_Changes.pdf (summary), usage_estimate.xlsx

Thanks,
Sarah Lewis
Sr. PM, Integrations — NovaApps
phone: +1 415-555-0192

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lewis <sarah.lewis@novaapps.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Order Form change — requested throughput increase + SOW clarifications

Thanks Sarah — got it and appreciate the detail. Short answers and proposed next steps: 

1) Mechanism: this will be a Change Order (amendment to the existing Order Form) that references the MSA and includes a short SOW exhibit for the ingestion/acceptance updates.

2) Ballpark pricing: preliminary estimate is ~+38% on monthly committed fees for the extra reserved capacity; I'll confirm exact SKU mapping after legal/finance run the redlines.

3) Timing: we can aim for the September onboarding target if we lock the Change Order by EOD next Wednesday (2026-09-08) so ops can provision the extra pool and QA can update acceptance tests. 

Next steps (proposed):
- I will draft a Change Order and circulate a clean + tracked version (attachment: proposed_change_order_draft.docx).
- Laura, can you route to Legal (Karthik) for prioritized redlines? We should highlight any price-cap or early-termination impacts.
- Sarah, please confirm the acceptance criteria lines in the SOW (I'll include the bullet list from your attachment as an exhibit).

I'll slot a 20-min sync for Wednesday afternoon in case there are open questions; feel free to propose a different time.

Attachments: proposed_change_order_draft.docx

Thanks — Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Commercial Ops — Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Order Form change — requested throughput increase + SOW clarifications

Karthik — forwarding NovaApps' change request and Marcus' draft Change Order. Please prioritize this for redline; they are asking for a September onboarding and we should aim to keep the commercial exposure limited.

Key legal points to check / requested items from Legal:
- Confirm whether a price-cap/ceiling clause is required by Finance given the ~38% uplift.
- Ensure the SOW acceptance criteria map to measurable test cases (we should not leave it as vague "performance tests").
- Verify that the amendment references the correct MSA effective date and that the Exhibit numbering won't conflict with prior signed Exhibits.
- Add a fallback routing policy: if Redwood cannot provision the extra capacity by the committed date, define remediation (credits, extended onboarding, or temporary burst).

I've attached a short annotated copy with in-line comments (msaref_redlines_annotated.pdf). Marcus — if Legal signs off by Wednesday EOD (2026-09-08) we can route for signatures on Thursday.
